title.$description: Headings — Host Grotesk (variable, wght 300-800), self-hosted OFL-1.1. Same family as `body`: one display/body face, weight is what distinguishes a heading (decision of 2026-09-25).

body.$description: Body copy — Host Grotesk (variable, wght 300-800), self-hosted OFL-1.1. See `tool/font-licences.md`.

mono.$description: Data/code/identifiers only (OTP digits, exported JSON, package ids, tag pills) — never body prose, never eyebrow labels (app-design spec §1.2 correction). IBM Plex Mono (static, weight 400), self-hosted OFL-1.1. See `tool/font-licences.md`.

caption.$description: Fine print, legal footnotes, timestamps, copyright (12px). Host Grotesk 400.

body-sm.$description: Secondary text, list subtitles, helper text (14px). Host Grotesk 400.

eyebrow.$description: Section labels, status tags (14px). Host Grotesk 600, uppercase, `letter-spacing: 0.04em` — never IBM Plex Mono (app-design spec §1.2's 2026-09-25 correction note: the website's own `.hero__eyebrow` inherits the body font, it does not set `font-family: var(--font-mono)`).

body.$description: Default paragraph/list text (16px). The floor, not a stylistic choice — below 16px Safari/iOS auto-zooms a focused form input. Host Grotesk 400.

h3.$description: Card/group title, dialog title (16px). Host Grotesk 600.

lede.$description: Website-only: the hero lead paragraph (18px), matching the reference site's `--text-lg` "lead paragraph" role. No app screen has a lede; this role doesn't appear in the app-design spec's own scale.

h2.$description: Section heading within a screen (20px). Host Grotesk 700.

h1.$description: Screen title, one per screen (24px). Host Grotesk 700.

display.$description: The one place a number/heading should dominate — app paywall price; website section heads (32px), matching the reference site's `--text-3xl`. Host Grotesk 700.

hero-1.$description: Website-only: hero headline, mobile (44px) — matches the reference site's `--text-4xl`. The app-design spec explicitly has no use for this size ("the website's 56/72px hero sizes have no use case here").

hero-2.$description: Website-only: hero headline, tablet+ (56px) — matches the reference site's `--text-5xl`.

hero-3.$description: Website-only: hero headline, desktop (72px) — matches the reference site's `--text-6xl`.

mono-data.$description: OTP code entry, exported JSON block, package identifiers (16px). IBM Plex Mono 400.

product.$description: Role-named product type scale (app-design spec §1.2), shared by the app and the website. Replaces the old numeric `xs`/`sm`/`base`/… minor-third ramp entirely — that ramp, and the `typography.*` composite block that used to sit above this one, were copied from an unrelated diagram/chart design system, not authored for this app (see `tokens/README.md` and the app-design spec's §0 "headline finding"). `lede`/`hero-1`/`hero-2`/`hero-3` are website-only additions the app-design spec explicitly has no use for; every other role is shared.
